propositions: During a single reconcile pass, per-project config resolution via config.effective_* runs redundantly once per ticket instead of once per distinct project, causing repeated filesystem discovery and overlay resolution (perf issue, not correctness).

A pass-scoped memo dict keyed by (axis, project_key) will deduplicate config resolution: _memoize_effective helper will check cache before computing and store result, reducing calls from N tickets to M distinct projects.

The cache dict is created fresh in compute_outbound_mutations and threaded through _effective_*_for helpers and mutation builders, ensuring pass-scoped lifetime with no process-global state or cross-pass leakage.
Emitted mutations and output remain unchanged: each ticket's mutation still reflects its own project's [mapping] overlay, verified by per-project correctness assertions.
